policy_rejections.title: Cosmic Buddha full-resolution no-texture
policy_rejections.reason: Rejected before download: 2.88 GiB and roughly 62 million faces exceed this baseline corpus budget; the Smithsonian 150k derivative is retained.

policy_rejections.title: Gisant test
policy_rejections.reason: Rejected before download: source labels the asset only as a test and does not provide sufficient object provenance for the curated corpus.

policy_rejections.title: Generic Moai rendering
policy_rejections.reason: Rejected before download: generic rendering rather than a documented scan or identified heritage object.

policy_rejections.title: Open Heritage 3D general project downloads
policy_rejections.reason: Rejected as an acquisition route for this sprint: downloads require user identity fields and many projects prohibit commercial use.

policy_rejections.title: Sketchfab models without anonymous downloads
policy_rejections.reason: Rejected as an acquisition route unless mirrored by a public repository with model-level license evidence; direct downloads can require login.

policy_rejections.title: Paid marketplace statue meshes
policy_rejections.reason: Rejected by policy: paid, private, or redistribution-restricted assets are outside this dataset.
